task_completion.description: Weasis medical viewer is launched and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is open, showing the DICOM viewer interface.

task_completion.description: The workspace layout is configured to a 1x2 grid (two side-by-side panes).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main viewing area is split into exactly two vertical panes (left and right).

task_completion.description: Slice synchronization between the two panes is disabled.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Link' or 'Sync' icon in the toolbar or pane headers is toggled off, or the panes show different slice numbers/content independently.

task_completion.description: The left pane shows a slice from the beginning of the series and the right pane shows a slice from the end.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The slice indicators (e.g., '1/10' on the left and '10/10' or '9/10' on the right) show widely separated indices from the 10-slice series.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the screenshot and the completion text file to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or a file explorer window shows the creation of 'async_comparison.png' and 'task_complete.txt' in ~/DICOM/exports/.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Weasis GUI to change layouts and slices rather than just using CLI tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor moving to layout menus, scrollbars, or sync toggle buttons within the Weasis interface.

integrity.description: The images displayed are actual DICOM renders, not placeholder images.
integrity.visual_evidence: The panes contain CT scan cross-sections with associated DICOM metadata overlays (Patient ID, Slice Number) consistent with the 10-slice series.

integrity.description: The task_complete.txt file was created after the GUI actions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamp of the terminal command creating the text file occurs after the visual configuration of the Weasis workspace.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The CT series contains exactly 10 slices. The agent must disable synchronization to show different slices simultaneously. The expected output files are /home/ga/DICOM/exports/async_comparison.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/task_complete.txt (containing 'async_done').
